product_overview: A unified platform combining messaging, e-commerce, and AI-driven automation to manage conversations, run online stores with dynamic storefronts, and handle billing/subscriptions across multi-tenant customers.
core_goals: Provide a manifest-driven, themeable storefront runtime that renders atomic sections dynamically.
Support a complete customer purchase journey from discovery to secure checkout with coupon and payment handling.
Unify customer conversations (multi-channel) with AI-powered assistants and RAG-enhanced responses.
Offer subscription and store/settings management for authenticated users and companies.
Ensure resilience with self-healing frontend behaviors and robust error handling.
Support internationalization (i18n) and RTL/LTR layouts for multi-language stores.
Enforce security best practices (JWT auth, rate limiting, permission checks).

features.name: Storefront Template Rendering
features.description: Render storefront pages from a manifest-driven layout composed of atomic sections (Hero, Featured Collection, etc.), with theme switching via URL parameters and runtime fallback handling.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Append ?layout=aura-chic to URL -> See Hero section rendered -> See Featured Collection section rendered -> Scroll to Featured Products section -> See products loaded
Navigate to / -> Append ?layout=invalid-theme to URL -> See 'Failed to load section' error banner -> Click Retry button -> See default layout rendered as fallback
Navigate to /shop -> Append ?layout=creative to URL -> See collection hero rendered -> Click a Featured product card -> Navigate to /product/42

features.name: Customer Purchase Journey
features.description: Allow customers to discover products, add items to cart from shop or product pages, apply coupons, and complete checkout via a secure flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> Browse collections and product cards -> Click product card to open /product/42 -> See product details loaded -> Click Add to Cart -> Navigate to /cart -> See product listed in cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout -> Fill payment details -> Enter coupon code SUMMER -> Click Apply Coupon -> Click Complete Order -> See order confirmation

Navigate to /shop -> Click product card to open /product/42 -> Click Add to Cart -> Navigate to /cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout -> Enter coupon code INVALID -> Click Apply Coupon -> See 'Coupon invalid or expired' message

Navigate to /shop -> Click product card to open /product/42 -> Click Add to Cart -> Navigate to /cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout -> Fill payment details with expired card -> Click Complete Order -> See payment failure message -> Click Retry Payment -> See payment retry flow

features.name: Subscription Management
features.description: Authenticated users can view and manage billing and subscription plans, update payment methods, and change or cancel plans from the subscription page.
user_flows: Authenticate as a user -> Navigate to /subscription -> See current plan and billing details -> Click Change Plan -> Select new plan -> Click Update Subscription -> See success confirmation
Navigate to /subscription without authentication -> See access denied message or redirect to login -> Cannot view subscription details
Authenticate as a user -> Navigate to /subscription -> Click Update Payment Method -> Enter invalid card details -> Click Save -> See payment method validation error

features.name: Store and Profile Settings
features.description: Provide company and store-level settings editing, including store metadata, integrations, and AI/notification preferences via a settings UI.
user_flows: Authenticate as a user -> Navigate to /settings -> See profile and store settings sections -> Edit Store Name field -> Click Save -> See 'Settings saved' notification
Authenticate as a user -> Navigate to /settings -> Clear required Store Name field -> Click Save -> See validation error 'Store name is required'
Authenticate as a user -> Navigate to /settings -> Switch language preference to Arabic -> See UI update to RTL layout and translated strings
